title: Ashon Galaxy Breaks Through the Noise with “Don’t Listen To Them”
htmlContent: Ashon Galaxy is back with a confident new single through "Don't Listen To Them," and it's more than meets the ear. Draped in the warmth of modern R&B and kissed by traces of Latino music, this track is a sultry ride through a territory that's part known, part mysterious. "Don't Listen To Them" is a layered emotional journey, a story of denial, defiance, and guarded softness. It's a story shared not in grand pronouncements, but in careful nuance, layered harmonies, and rich instrumentation that should ring as loud as any one lyric. Ashon's voice, delivered with the same attention to form as his dancing, is equally captivating, silky yet pointed, and soaring above a groove that draws on both contemporary R&B and timeless Latin rhythmic models. There is a push and pull that mirrors the emotional tension of the song. You can sense the warring emotion behind the lyrics, the pushback against the messages of others, and the vile influence of honesty, even if that honesty is the last thing you want to hear. What makes "Don't Listen To Them" stand out is the subtle power in the storytelling. This is not a belted heartbreak anthem or a melodramatic breakup ballad. It's about blocking out the noise, even if the noise is coming from somewhere in your own heart. https://open.spotify.com/track/0wBUJ5RaCUw7Sc2xTHC5KZ Ashon Galaxy has the ability to create music that is deeply personal yet somehow also universal, with her latest single being no exception. It's a song that you carry around with you long after you first hear it, whose emotional surfaces offer up new textures with every spin. Amid a musical terrain full of quick hits and fast rewards, "Don't Listen To Them" is a slow-burn, deliberate, textured, and emotional track. Ashon Galaxy is constructing landscapes that demand you feel deeply and listen closely.
